 # Changelog
 
+## [0.34.1] - 2026-11-15
+
+Metadata only: nothing the server reads, writes or shows changed, so it is
+safe to take at any point.
+
+### Changed
+- The PyPI summary, the MCP registry entry (a new `title` and its
+  description) and the README heading now open with "AI tools for Final Cut
+  Pro", the words people type into search (Google autocomplete, checked
+  2026-11-15: "final cut pro ai tools", "final cut pro ai", "fcpxml"). It is
+  called an MCP server, never a plugin: it does not run inside Final Cut.
+- PyPI keywords add `final-cut-pro-ai`, `fcpx` and `video-review`.
+
 ## [0.34.0] - 2026-11-15
 
 A timeline that reads at a glance, in one look. James picked direction B

+# The searched phrase leads the heading, then the name (0.34.1, James's rule

+PHRASE = "AI tools for Final Cut Pro"
 SUBTITLE = "Reads and writes FCPXML, no plugin, no patch"
 BENEFIT = "Edit Final Cut Pro by talking to Claude, and watch the cut change."
 
 
 def test_readme_opens_with_the_name_then_the_benefit_then_the_subtitle():
     lines = [line for line in (REPO / "README.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
     at = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith("# "))
-    assert lines[at] == f"# {NAME}"
+    assert lines[at] == f"# {PHRASE}: {NAME}"
     assert lines[at + 1] == f"**{BENEFIT}**"
     # non-breaking spaces keep "no plugin, no patch" together on a phone
     assert lines[at + 2].replace(" ", " ") == SUBTITLE
